jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: Ran release engineering for 100 engineers across 180 repositories, coordinating with the compliance, security and engineering teams.
Led the migration of 180+ codebases from Forgejo to self-hosted GitLab.

Built CI/CD pipelines for 40+ microservices: automated testing, containerized builds and GitOps deployments through ArgoCD and Kubernetes. Manual release work dropped by 90%, and releases went from fortnightly to daily.
Improved CI observability and enforced CODEOWNERS, merge request approvals and coverage checks, so developers trust a change before it reaches production.
Built UAT environments that mirror production, and designed ephemeral cluster environments on real infrastructure so developers can validate a service before merge.
Improved observability, autoscaling policies and infrastructure reliability across services.

jobs.title: Founder
description: Built a hiring platform where infrastructure candidates debug a simulated real incident, and we measure how they work.
Sold it myself: more than 100 prospect conversations, closing Scaler, Fampay and ArcFront.
Customers hired a Head of Infra, SDE 2s, database administrators and security engineers with it, and hiring for those roles went from weeks to days.
Raised angel funding and received acquisition offers. Customer demand to run AI agents through the same incidents led me into agent evaluation.
